figures.caption: Fig. 4. One-dimensional TML model with a length of L [cm]. Although a discrete model is depicted, zA, zB, and zC are inﬁnitesimal elements, with [V cm1], [V cm], and [V cm1] dimensions, respectively. The current in the upper line is a function of the position x [cm], and is represented as I(x) [A]. Since the condition is under a ﬁxed total current of IT [A], the current in the bottom line is IT  I(x). The potential difference between the two lines is represented as E(x) [V].
